evidence_basis: National NHS England pilot lab-arm site (Dec 2024-Apr 2025, EV01). Pooled lab arm: 88% of patients needing clopidogrel were discharged before the result. Timing Possible, readiness Medium (override). Time-sensitivity score 88 is the highest of the seven.
main_caveat: The 88% is pooled across three lab sites, company-reported, and the route may have changed since. Readiness Medium keeps balanced rank at 13th; 4th on the fit-led lens.
next_step: Confirm current testing route and turnaround at the trust and whether the lab arm continued after the pilot.

evidence_basis: National NHS England pilot lab-arm site (EV01, EV07). Doncaster and Bassetlaw tested 130 stroke patients Dec 2024-Apr 2025; 20% had a reduced-response variant. Timing Possible, readiness Medium (override).
main_caveat: Candidate on evidence, not on numbers: lowest volume of the seven (about 330 tests a year) and short stay, so ranks 64th. The 20% reduced-response rate is lower than the 29-33% seen elsewhere.
